result.summary: Workspace deletion already removes the WorkOS organization, then the sync handler deletes it again, so a 404 is the success state. Mapping that 404 and treating it as already deleted matches membership and role deletes and still fails other WorkOS errors.

problems.title: Tests skip the real WorkOS 404 path
problems.detail: The unit test stubs the SDK throw. The litest stubs the client to already return entity_not_found. Neither run wrap then the aggregate together against a live-shaped WorkOS error.
